payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate total sum S from 0 to 300000 step 3; set diagonal cells to make each row sum S; check if new diagonal sum equals S; break on first match.
payload.rationale: Limited to complete_search candidates. The solution does a simple linear search over S, with a check that acts as a bound. No branching or backtracking, but branch_and_bound is the least mismatching subtype, as it enumerates a parameter space with a termination condition.
